question: Who among the following has become the first woman umpire to officiate in a men’s Test match in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Claire Polosak**__.

__
 
• **Claire Polosak has become the first woman umpire to officiate in a men’s Test match in January 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Australia’s Claire Polosak created history by becoming the first woman umpire to officiate a men’s Test during India vs Australia match at the Sydney Cricket Ground on 7 Jan 2021.
 
 
• **She was appointed as the fourth umpire in the third Test of the Border-Gavaskar trophy**, while Australians Paul Reiffel and Paul Wilson were serving as the on-field umpires.
 
• The fourth umpire at a test match has duties related to pitch preparation, equipment changes and support for the on-field umpires.
 
• She was also the first woman umpire to stand in an Australian men’s domestic fixture after officiating a one-day match between New South Wales and a Cricket Australia XI in 2017.
 
 
 
• In 2016, New Zealand's Kathy Cross and Polosak became the first two female umpires to officiate at the Women's World T20.
